ActorTalk: Tabula Akasha is far more than a building. It is a civilization-preservation project led by Qu, Monarch of Kowloong, with the aid of the AI Huaxu. By storing human consciousness as data within a virtual realm, it allows civilization to endure even as the Punishing ravages the world outside.

<size=25>The Tabula Akasha's structure itself is a fusion of Kowloong's traditional architecture and advanced technology. Its sweeping eaves and bracketed forms trace back to Golden Age East Asian buildings, while metal and translucent materials reflect the hard-earned survival wisdom of the post-apocalyptic era. Even so, it preserves the symbolic gesture of eaves reaching toward the heavens.</size>
